name: Donmac e-Mobility
tagline: Accelerating the transition to electric transportation.
heroText: Electric vehicles, intelligent charging infrastructure and sustainable mobility solutions designed for Africa.
introTitle: Clean transportation for a cleaner Zambia.
intro: Donmac e-Mobility is building Zambia's electric-mobility ecosystem: sourcing and supplying electric vehicles, designing and installing charging infrastructure, and helping fleets move to clean, cost-efficient transport. We are an RTSA-licensed motor dealer and a member of the Zambian Electric Mobility Innovation Alliance (ZEMIA).
